services.desc: At Electrified, we built a financing system around one idea: your ability to ride shouldn’t depend on your credit history. Whether you’re commuting to work, chasing better weekends, or reclaiming the mobility you thought you’d lost, we have a plan that puts you on a bike today not “someday.” Fifty dollars down. No credit check. No hoops. We know a purchase like this can feel like it demands sacrifice, so we built something different a path that lets you get the experience you’re after without draining your savings to do it.
